name: Ember — Animated Background
description: Animate your own image with a dithered shader behind a new tab field that works like the browser's own. History, bookmarks and open tabs are read on this device for the field's suggestions and never sent anywhere; images stay local.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; connect-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'
